statement: For every finite linear triple system with m triples, Q=sum_v binom(t_v,2) and binary incidence N, the F5 code D=im(N) has at least4m,4Q,12Q,16*(binom(m,2)-Q) distinct words of weights3,4,5,6 respectively. If its point count n>6 and j_n belongs to D, it also has at least4m words of weight n-3 and12m+4 words of weight n. For every complete simple SRG(99,14,1,2), the corresponding bounds at weights3,4,5,6,96,99 are924,8316,24948,391776,924,2776. These are separate lower bounds, not a complete image description; no nonzero left code, rank improvement or target existence/exclusion is forced.

scope.description: Finite linear triple systems overF5 and their image words; conditional application to every complete target actual-triangle incidence. Scalar coefficient recovery, constant-word translates and exact character necessary inequalities only. No fixed17 profile or code/graph realization assertion.

dependency_reason: The coefficient and support recovery is supplied directly. Prior binary image proofs and characteristic-specific coding sources are comparison/shared ancestry. Support55 is not needed for the count theorem; it is only a future optional restriction in the proposed necessary enumerator experiment.
assumptions: Distinct triples are three-element subsets and any two intersect in at most one point.
Every code/image word is overF5; characteristic-two recovery is explicitly outside the cancelling-pair proof.
Only the last two general counts require n>6 and j_n in the image.
For target specialization N includes all actual triangles once, with row sums7, column sums3, m231 and Q2079.
limitations: These are distinct constructed words and separate lower bounds, not a complete image census or additive claim at coincident weights.
High full-weight count requires n>6 and the all-one image premise; the n6 boundary demonstrably fails an unqualified count.
General linear triple systems do not imply C subset D, target parameters, rank or a nonzero left code.
No LP optimum, code realization, rank improvement, target existence/exclusion, fixed17 profile or graph object follows.
Bounded historical excerpts and source hash identities are not exhaustive novelty/literature verification or fresh endorsement of archive computations.
Written checking and displayed finite hand cases only; no executable controls, solver, enumerator, formal/external checker or scientific gate.
shared_components: Root requested a different quinary follow-up; Structural authored the candidate. Native independently derived all low/high counts, a separate no-four-column-relation challenge, the character convention and displayed hand boundaries.
The exact character identity is classical and shares historical binary-note ancestry. No binary gate or executable code was transferred to this F5 statement.
